ranking.metaDescription: How CarPal orders shops and parts: proven work for your exact car, confirmed reviews, availability and distance. No paid ranking.
ranking.title: How ranking works
ranking.intro: CarPal orders shops and parts by how well they fit your car and your problem, based on evidence. Nobody can pay to rank higher.
ranking.capabilityText: Completed jobs and confirmed reviews for your exact brand, model and series in the repair area you need count most. A claim without evidence counts almost nothing.
ranking.trustText: Ratings from confirmed reviews, weighted towards recent ones. Reviews written after a confirmed appointment count fully; reviews approved by the business and CarPal count for less.
ranking.operationalText: How soon they can see you and how quickly they answer requests.
ranking.distanceText: Straight-line distance from you, your chosen city or the map centre, within the area the shop serves.
ranking.preferenceText: A shop you saved gets a small bonus. It can never jump over much better-proven shops.
ranking.partsText: How sure the seller is that the part fits your car, whether it is in stock, the seller's rating, distance and how complete the listing is. Price is a filter, not a score.
ranking.ruleNoPaid: No hidden paid ranking. Plans and payments never change the order. Featured places, when they exist, are labelled and never shown on the map.
ranking.ruleEvidence: Evidence over claims. A shop with verified jobs in a repair area always ranks above one that only says it does that work.
ranking.ruleExplain: Every result explains itself. You see why a shop is shown: jobs on your car, ratings, availability, distance.
ranking.ruleSame: The same ranking everywhere: search, Help Me and the map use the same scores.
ranking.badgesText: Badges are given automatically when the evidence is there, and removed when it is not — for example when fake reviews are found or a business is suspended.
